description: Amplifies noise in one feature's relationship with the outcome, making its predictions highly uncertain.
business_question: For one column, {OUTCOME_COL} results stay fairly close together at one end of the column but become much more spread out at the other end. Which column shows this uneven level of consistency? Return a single column name.
ds_question: Which feature's relationship with {OUTCOME_COL} is most unreliable — i.e., has the highest prediction uncertainty? Return a single column name.
